mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below -50,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer and business confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 indicates growing domestic demand for goods, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates softening domestic demand or supply constraints, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in softening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL above 0.2% indicates accelerating inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to raise rates, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in accelerating periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer and business confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
